topic: memory leak — closure capturing large object inside a setInterval that's never cleared
question: Quick reminder — what was the actual root cause?
butterfly_answer: The `setInterval` heartbeat in `src/ws/session.js` was never cleared when the session closed. Its closure held a reference to `sessionState` (~2MB), so every closed session leaked that memory — the interval kept running and the GC couldn't collect the state.
lastN_answer: The prior context doesn't mention a root cause — the conversation was entirely about code quality items (error messages, naming, dependencies, test file size, eslint). No bug or incident root cause came up.
needle_fact: The setInterval heartbeat in onConnection (src/ws/session.js) is never cleared on socket close — its closure captures sessionState, retaining the ~2MB initialPayload buffer per disconnected session.
